Open the [read-later completion prototype](http://maker:4001/index.html?flow=read-later&state=has-item). Select **Mark as read** on the GitHub Copilot card, then open **All bookmarks** and confirm that the card is still there.

I’ve assumed the completion control belongs directly on the card while viewing Read later, and that clearing the last item shows an “all caught up” state.
